Payout panel (/profile?tab=payout) now correctly renders IN-GAME state: payout-status='Jugando ahora' (green), payout-per-hour='5,250', session timer increments (00m 11s -> 00m 15s), and 'Próximo pago de 350' countdown animates (03m 48s -> 03m 45s).
